H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H5035: a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form)
H6218: ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H3190: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)
H5059: properly, to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers; expectation. to play on astringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music
H8643: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H530: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H8415: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1481: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H8398: the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H6098: advice; by implication, plan; also prudence
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H5106: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
H4284: a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H977: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H5027: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H4349: properly, a fixture, i.e. a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode
H7688: to peep, i.e. glance sharply at
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H3335: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H3581: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H5483: a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight)
H8668: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
H4422: properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3176: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H2442: properly, to adhere to; hence, to await
H4043: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
